{{Quote|Speeders? Protect the generator at all costs!|Asajj Ventress, during the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''super tank shield generator''', known more commonly as the '''mobile shield generator''', was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] vehicle that saw use in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Similar in appearance to the larger [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]], the super [[Tank/Legends|tank]] shield generator was a mobile [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] that was used to [[Deflector shield/Legends|protect]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the front lines of battle. It was deployed in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] campaigns at [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]; in the latter campaign, it was deployed in conjunction with the super tank.
